statutes.title: Taxes and Tax Rates - Individuals
text_en: Imposes a flat individual income tax rate of 2.50% on Arizona taxable income, enacted by SB 1828 to replace graduated individual tax brackets.
text_es: Impone una tasa impositiva fija del 2.50% sobre el ingreso gravable de Arizona de individuos, promulgada bajo SB 1828 eliminando tramos graduales anteriores.

statutes.title: Definitions - Resident and Presumption of Residency
text_en: Defines resident as every individual in Arizona for other than a temporary or transitory purpose; individuals spending in the aggregate more than nine months (270 days) of the tax year in state are presumed residents.
text_es: Define residente como todo individuo en Arizona para fines no temporales ni transitorios; quien pase en agregado más de nueve meses (270 días) en el estado se presume residente.
